movie.title: Night Nurse
movie.overview: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

reviews.author: larz9
reviews.content:
Absolutely colossal waste of time. A movie that is more salacious (for the sake of being salacious) than any semblance of a drama or thriller.

I'm going to be a lot more discerning about writers and directors in future selections.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a wave of unsettling scam calls strikes a quiet retirement community, an idealistic nurse finds herself drawn into the complex life of a secretive patient.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In a seemingly tranquil retirement community, an influx of disturbing, perverse scam calls creates an atmosphere of paranoia and vulnerability among the elderly residents. Amidst this rising tension, a starry-eyed and empathetic nurse attempts to maintain order while caring for a enigmatic new patient. As their connection grows deeper, the lines between professional duty and personal fascination blur. She soon discovers that her patient's past may be directly connected to the sinister events haunting the facility.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set within the manicured grounds of an idyllic retirement village, the story begins as residents become targets of an increasingly invasive and perverse phone scam ring. The mysterious callers manipulate the vulnerable community, triggering deep anxiety and unraveling the quiet safety of the home. Enter a dedicated, starry-eyed nurse whose optimism often puts her at odds with the cynical realities of her job. Her routine is upended when she is assigned to a mysterious patient who guards his past with intense secrecy. Magnetically drawn to his complex persona, she begins spending her off-hours probing into his life, ignoring subtle warning signs along the way. As the scam calls escalate into physical threats against the residents, the nurse uncovers troubling clues suggesting her patient is not merely an innocent bystander. Her growing obsession threatens her career, her safety, and her perception of truth as she tries to untangle his real identity. Ultimately, she must navigate a dangerous game of psychological cat-and-mouse to protect her residents and uncover the truth before the malicious forces consume them all.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Night Nurse is a tense dramatic thriller that explores vulnerability, trust, and obsession within a secluded retirement community. When disturbing scam calls disrupt the peaceful haven of the elderly residents, an optimistic nurse seeks to restore sense and comfort to her environment. However, her focus shifts dramatically after she forms an intense connection with a secretive, newly admitted patient. As the external threat of the phone scams intensifies, her burgeoning relationship pulls her into a web of deceit, forcing her to question the true motives of everyone around her in a high-stakes investigation of identity and guilt.
